notes.title: Ver 1.0.2 - Minor Patch
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, fellow Gamers!
Ver 1.0.2 has been updated.

[/h3]
[b][h3][Major Issues][/h3][/b]
- This is a modified patch based on the bugs and feedbacks reported after the official launch.
It's a patch that focuses primarily on pleasant play.

[b][h3][Game Play][/h3][/b]
- Dash distance increased by 20%.

- Charged Blow's motion delay has been reduced.
: Average reduction of 20%

- The starting speed of Descending Attack increased and the motion delay decreased.
: 30~50% Faster
: Lance's Descending Attack damage reduced by 17%.

- It's possible to curl up immediately on Motion Delay after the attack.

- Some of the boss's patterns and attack judgments have been adjusted.
: Adjusting that too wide a judging range
: Adjusting that too fast attack speed
: No turning immediately after attack trigger.

- The collision range of the monster and the collision damage have been reduced.
: Average 40% reduction in collision range
: Average 50% reduction in collision damage
: Bosses have also been adjusted.

- The collision judgment of some airborne monsters has been deleted.

- Some monster's attack range has been reduced.

- Some monster's attack speed has been reduced.

- You can see the NPC's next lines with a mouse click.

[b][h3][Bug Fix][/h3][/b]
- Fixed a problem that could not change resolution on a specific monitor.

- Some incorrect position of shot VFX has been modified.

- The issue of achievement completion has been corrected.
: The One Who Tried to Erase the Past

- The invisible hero issue has been corrected.

- The phenomenon of weapons turning white has been corrected.

- The decimal error in the map discovery rate has been corrected.

notes.title: Ver 1.0 - Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, fellow Gamers!
Finally, ver 1.0 has been updated.

The official launch of 3000th Duel is December 12.
It will be switched between 16:00 and 17:00 tomorrow.(PST)

We look forward to your feedback even after the official launch.
Details below, Please check.[/h3]

[h2][b][Major Issues][/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35695428/3513b07b9f3f381d416e624e651ebb6d923460a4.png[/img]
- The planned cinematic scenes has been updated, including opening scene.
The story is complete.

- The Level Design has been refined to make it easier for you to explore.

- Balance and translation have been refined.
And convenience features were added.


[h2][b][Game Play][/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35695428/0330867929136d3c37f87b5db1d975e65b05228c.png[/img]
- The Level Design of 'Forest of Old Memories' has been changed.
It was adjusted more easily for beginners.

- Icons for weapon type has been added.

- Weapon Type skills have been supplemented with descriptions and icons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35695428/7361190e3af27e0d5f68105ee6333e1c70ce730d.png[/img]
- Portal zone has been added in 'Canal of Ruins' and 'Top of the Castle'.

- Items that can be sold to stores have been added.
: Karma Fragment, Karma Crystal, Karma Nugget

- Conversations in NPC proceed faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35695428/b2270b2513f5561d39f54d818111469e24bb4b77.png[/img]
- You can add markers to any location on the map.
A maximum of 25 can be added.

- Core Skill's marker icon has changed.

- Acceleration has been added to allow fine scrolling of the map.

- Sealed Skill Button flashes when available.

- The detailed play record is output after the ending.

- The speed of the bottom attacks has increased.
: Blade and Lance increased by 80%
: Broadsword increased by 30%

- When the bottom attack was successful, the character was treated to avoid being pushed.

- Lance's performance has been upgraded.
: Attack range increased by 30%
: Increased speed of 3 hit by 45%
: Increased damage of 2 hit by 30%

- Debuff performance of some monsters has been reduced.

- Translation quality has improved.


[h2][b][Bug Fix][/b][/h2]
- Bug fixed that NPC's lines sometimes blink.

- Bug fixed in which a monster rolls on a moving platform.

- Bug fixed that sometimes the character's landing motion does not play.

- Bug fixed that move during bottom attack.

notes.title: Ver 0.9.20 - Major Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi~ Gamers!
Ver 0.9.20 has been updated.

This update is based on feedback form gamers.
We'll continue to listen to the feedback of gamers.
And we will do our best to become a more perfect game.[/h1]

[b][h1][Major Issues][/h1][/b]
[b]1. Stories Reinforcement[/b]
Stories have been reinforced to deliver a much more dramatic worldview and storyline of the game.
It tells the story in many different ways, like cinematic scene, interaction with NPCs, fragment of memory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35695428/20b2cda9c96d3270bcd325ee6a705c7d2488d8da.png[/img]

[b]2. Interaction of NPCs[/b]
Unique features have been added to NPC in the game.
You can trade items and enhance Weapons and Occults.
You can also see hints that will help you play the game.

[b]3. Quick Change of Weapons and Occults[/b]
Weapons and Occults can be quickly changed with dedicated buttons.
Not only is it convenient, it also enables much faster and more creative battles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35695428/836894881f343ef233f06472d81ae4eecfd4c4cc.gif[/img]

[b]4. Markers on Map[/b]
Now you can conveniently check the map for items you have not acquired and the location of boss and karma.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35695428/bb097136a18aa1508c285025f8236652a6716d6b.png[/img]

[b]5. Display Damage Numbers[/b]
The damage to the attack is expressed in numbers.

[b]6. Expressions of Attribute Weapons[/b]
Dedicated VFX and SFX have been applied to the attribute weapon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35695428/3da556a365a4a2fb8b2dd507ef033fce93bb4233.png[/img]

[b]7. Overall Balance Improvement[/b]
Overall, we've improved our balance around feedback.
We will do our best to minimize the difficulties and absurdities of the game.

[b]8. New BGM[/b]
Added Title BGM, boss and region BGM.

[b]9. Addition of the Crouching Attacks[/b]
It has been added a weapons-specific crouching attack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35695428/f249ab5cb73d9766fbe8966bb862102ecba3aba3.png[/img]

[b][h1][Game Play][/h1][/b]
- Added OCC (Occult ATK)
    :  If you level up the Mind, not only the MP growth, but also the OCC.
    : OCC for each occult is set differently and further growth can be achieved by enhancing the occult.
    : OCC is set on some accessories.

- Added Items
    : Merchant’s Return Stone has been added to allow immediate teleportation to merchant.
    : 6 materials have been added for enhancements.

- Level design has been modified to make it easier to move.

- The selected lines will be highlighted in the conversation with NPC.

- Improved readability of Debuff & Buff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35695428/7d560da9fb9aa790bf2e1f743379efefe83fdad4.png[/img]

- Added 20 fragment of memory.

- Added 4 Achievements.

- Boss Clear Effects has been reinforced.

- The latest translation has been applied to 11 languages.

[b][h1][Balance][/h1][/b]
- Monster's capabilities have been downgraded overall.

- Monster's Debuff performance has been downgraded overall.

- Weapons and accessories placement has been adjusted and acquisition probabilities have been raised.

- Attack speed of Broadsword 2Hit has increased by 20%.

- Mortal blow damage of averaging 25% higher.

- Delays were reduced after Descending Attack.

- Improved the efficiency of Descending Attacks.

- Overall, the performance of the occult has been upgraded.

- Overall, demand of occult devotion has been downgraded.

- The strike range of Fire Dance Contract has been adjusted.

- Capabilities of accessories has been raised three to four times overall.

- Karma heart's ability has been adjusted to match the flow of play.

[b][h1][Bug Fix][/h1][/b]
- Some load times are optimized.

- Incorrect location of NPC dialog button has been modified.

- Incorrect phenomenon of attack judgements for some bosses has been corrected.

[b][h1][Etc][/h1][/b]
- The key settings are initialized to default in addition to the Weapons and Occults Changing buttons.
